title: Responding (cross-regime orchestrator: user-prompt → SMD)
description: Regime: cross-regime composing morphism. Controller at stable-aperiodic-articulation-cell (platform-level). The substrate's entry point for 'user said something, return a markdown answer.' Per emsenn 2026-05-28 reframe (substrate-as-AI): this morphism IS the AI's perceive-think-act cycle: PERCEIVE (the user-prompt) → RECALL (deriving-relevance-frontier identifies known entities in the prompt) → DELIBERATE (if matches, project neighborhood to SHPs and ask the LLM for natural-language answer; if no matches, signal missing knowledge for acquisition) → REPORT (reduce {user-prompt, llm-models, contextCells} into an SMD for the user). Composes morphisms across all four regimes: predicating (deriving-relevance-frontier; ω < κ < ω₁), positing (projecting-knowledge-to-shps; κ = ω), articulating (inferring; κ ≥ ω₁), settling (reducing-to-smd; κ < ω). Each stage emits a witness row tagged with its regime.
